model.equation: Cl⁻ + CH₃Cl → CH₃Cl + Cl⁻ (identity substitution; entering and leaving Cl atoms are distinguishable labels)
model.conformation: Methyl substrate; backside Cl–C–Cl axis at the symmetric transition state. Full RC atom coordinates not reproduced here.
model.environment: Isolated gas-phase reactants, no solvent or counterion
model.atomMapping: Cl_in attacks C; Cl_out is the original CH₃Cl chlorine. At the symmetric TS Cl_in–C = C–Cl_out. Product identity is chemical, not an atom-identity swap in the mapping.

electronicStructure.method: OLYP density functional; activation-strain/KS-MO energy-decomposition analysis
electronicStructure.basis: TZ2P uncontracted Slater-type orbitals with diffuse functions
electronicStructure.software: Amsterdam Density Functional (ADF); PyFrag for activation strain
electronicStructure.geometryValidation: Publication Methods §2.1 reports vibrational analyses (minimum: real modes; TS: one imaginary mode) and IRC connectivity to the reactant/product minima. Atlas did not reproduce these calculations.
electronicStructure.fragmentConvention: Singlet Cl⁻ (−1) plus neutral singlet CH₃Cl (0); strain relative to isolated equilibrium fragments; interaction between deformed fragments at the same geometry.

reactionCoordinate.definition: The authors computed an IRC and project activation-strain curves onto C–Cl_out stretch relative to equilibrium; the figure's other coordinate uses Cl_in–C and C–Cl_out stretch with respect to the TS.
reactionCoordinate.displayPolicy: Only individually tabulated R, RC and TS values are selectable. They are not uniformly sampled IRC frames; no connecting energy line, moving atoms or interpolated geometry.

limitations: The teaching SN2 reaction is HO⁻ + CH₃Br, not this Cl⁻ + CH₃Cl identity substitution.

Table 1 gives one C–Cl_out distance per point, not full Cartesian frames; TS incoming distance follows symmetry only. Rendering is a labeled local bond diagram, not a molecular structure reconstruction.
Only R, RC and TS tabular energies are displayed; no IRC sample energies, smooth profile or experimental rate is available in this record.
The article validates its stationary points, but Atlas did not independently reproduce frequencies or an IRC.
Bond orders and electron-density change along the coordinate were not tabulated in the cited source locations.
Gas-phase electronic energies differ from standard-state Gibbs free energies, solvent barriers and dynamical observables.

interpretation.backside: Cl⁻ 3p donation into the backside lobe of σ*(C–Cl_out) accompanies C–Cl_in formation and C–Cl_out weakening. The published TS is symmetric and collinear in its Cl–C–Cl axis; no frontside barrier comparison is quantified by this record.
interpretation.sorgCaptures: 1122 indexes a closed-shell donor–acceptor displacement in which making C–Cl_in and breaking C–Cl_out are coupled along an approach–departure geometry.
interpretation.sorgOmits: Orbital energy, overlap, fragment strain and interaction, RC stability, exact distances, solvation, entropy, atom mapping and the TS/IRC topology are not encoded by 1122.
interpretation.bondOrder: C–Cl bond-order evolution is unavailable; the longer C–Cl_out distance and orbital explanation do not supply a numerical bond-order curve.
interpretation.density: The isolated CH₃Cl VDD carbon charge is reported, but no comparable RC/TS charge or density-difference series is transcribed; charge transfer magnitude is unavailable.
